title: a newcomer signs up, finishes onboarding and lands in the app

criteria.note: [V 2026-11-27] built by #1278 (F134 T1023; Reviewed by: second session with a linked review; deploy-health green on def1e35). Checked: yes through F134's own guards, tests/f134-visitors-read-rest.test.ts [guards F134.1] and tests/f134-writes-ask-first.test.tsx [guards F134.4], which assert the same claim; no F030 marker. Smoked: yes, `smoke-live` 2026-11-25 on e93e53c (run 45691147708, green, routes root and explore) and the signedOut persona passing root, explore and page on 2026-11-26 (71107bc); it checks only that a screen loads with no error and no stray email.

criteria.text: No "Make this yours" banner, no locality feed and no scope picker appear anywhere
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-27] the banner left in #1302 (human-review; 'Reviewed by: a second session … (requested next)', only COMMENTED reviews, so no; green on 60c7fe3); the feed, empty state and ScopePicker left in #1440 (closes #1363; Reviewed by: second session; green on e93e53c). grep of src finds 'Make this yours' only in BrowseSurface.test.tsx, whose test covers signed-in members on one surface; no standing guard scans signed-out surfaces. The locality_feed_items SQL function remains (dropping it needs a migration). Filed #1489. Smoked: yes, run 45691147708 on e93e53c (#1440's own merge) green on root and explore.

criteria.text: Email first: on sign-in, an email the app does not know goes to sign-up; one it knows asks for the password and signs the member in
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-27] cannot be met as written without reversing live rulings: members have one way in, the email then a 6-digit code (SignInForm, #946; signInWithOtp makes the account when the email is new, so there is no known/unknown fork and no password), and socialus-plan product/systems/member.md 2026-11-12 rules 'No passwords anywhere' with phone first (F081 2026-11-12, #1280). The password fork described here exists only at /auth/password, the unlinked page kept for evals and the live smoke (EmailFirstSignup). F030 was restated on 2026-11-26 'to match what is built'; this criterion describes the eval page, not the member path. Routed to scope-scenario (restate to the emailed code until #1280 lands).

criteria.text: Onboarding is one screen (legal name, display name, zip, 18+ box), then the market or the waiting screen, then an optional interests step; each step saves when submitted
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-27] OnboardingFlow: the profile form (#497, review-skipped, green on d5ebc93), then 'You're in {market}' or the waiting screen (#709, #1273), then 'What are you into?' with Save and Skip for now (#911, Reviewed by: the build agent itself, green on afcb911). Each step's server action saves on submit. The phone step (off until PHONE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, #707) would come first. OnboardingFlow.test.tsx and onboarding/actions.test.ts test parts, unmarked for F030; filed #1490. The legal name asked here is what runs today; F081's 2026-11-12 ruling ('never a legal name', #1280) will change it, as F030's Not this says. Smoked: unknown, /onboarding is skipped by the smoke (no stable live address).

criteria.text: At the end of onboarding the member sees the welcome screen once
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-27] finishOnboardingAction marks the login onboarded and redirects to /welcome (#1091, 'Reviewed by: pending', green on 5c3c24e); /welcome shows once and marks the login welcomed (#1133, 'Reviewed by: second session pending', green on fe89aee). welcome.test.tsx ('shows once') and actions.test.ts assert it, unmarked; filed #1492. Smoked: unknown, /welcome is not a smoke route.

criteria.text: Then the member lands in the chat front door (Explore until it exists)
criteria.note: [V 2026-11-27] not built: there is no chat route; the welcome's Get started goes to /, and src/proxy.ts sends a signed-in member to /explore, the scenario's interim landing. Needs the front door (#1328, F136, needs-pm, milestoned 2027-01-06). Ruling: what-this-is.md 2026-11-26, 'a new member lands in chat'. Filed #1494.

criteria.text: A member who came by a shared link lands where the link pointed instead
criteria.note: [V by reading 2026-11-27, not run] not built: a new member has no legal name, so src/proxy.ts redirects to /onboarding and drops the original path; /onboarding takes no next and OnboardingFlow always navigates to '/', so /welcome?next=/ follows. /welcome would honour next, and its header comment claims this behavior. Filed #1495.
